Definition: a trumpet (from its sundered or quavering note)
BiblicalUsage: The trumpet is the instrument of worship and of war, and it sounds at every great moment. All Israel brings up the ark with trumpets and shouting, the priests sound at the dedication of the temple, Phinehas carries the trumpets into the war against Midian, and the priests sound again when the foundation of the second temple is laid.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the trumpet belongs to God in worship and in battle alike. It calls the people to praise and it calls them to war, and in both cases it is God's sound, not man's.
RelatedEvents: David Brings the Ark to Jerusalem; Building of Solomon's Temple; War against Midian; Rebuilding of the Temple
